target_contract.exact_model_quantifiers_and_success: Complete original target and admissible counterexample, in the referenced problem and definitions.
target_contract.allowed_changes: Changing the original model, quantifiers or target requires an explicit new spec/RUN; notation and methods may evolve.
target_contract.completion: A complete original-scope proof or admissible counterexample; partial and conditional results retain their remaining obligations.

execution_notes.usage: Copy into the selected RUN workspace, fill real references, remove template_only, then pass this file directly to research studio init --spec. There is no nested math_spec to extract.
execution_notes.routing: studio init validates the expected branch/remote and records the actual opening snapshot. No manual registry fingerprint is required.
execution_notes.team: Main plus independent, informed-a, informed-b; actual Work launches only.
execution_notes.isolation: Independent input is the exact problem, definitions and allowed obstacles. Shared filesystem is not an access-control boundary.
execution_notes.saving: Continuous journal/save first; adopt only when using a hyperedge, freeze/review/promote only for a key result to reuse or publish.
